pages.title: Native and Cilbox
pages.description: The two ways to script Basis. Native scripts are compiled into the application; Cilbox scripts ship inside content and run at runtime in a sandbox.

pages.title: Common Usages
pages.description: The everyday building blocks of a Basis script, players, input, UI, timers, loading data, saving, menus and platform checks, each with a short example.

pages.title: Sandbox Rules
pages.description: The Cilbox rules that are not obvious from the API, and the performance costs to plan around.

pages.title: Allowed Components
pages.description: Which components survive in uploaded worlds, props and avatars, how to check, and how client builds add more.

pages.title: Avatar Scripting
pages.description: Cilbox scripts on avatars, the wearer versus everyone else, avatar ready events, and syncing avatar state.

pages.title: Networking

pages.title: Network Components
pages.description: The ready made components that sync pickups, seats, transforms, rigidbodies and parameters without code.

pages.title: Performance and Debugging
pages.description: Keeping networked content cheap, and tracking down objects that fall out of sync.

pages.title: Examples
pages.description: Complete, copyable scripts for common world and prop features, from a spinning cube to a networked scoreboard.

pages.title: Basics
pages.description: Your first Basis scripts, a spinning object and a UI button, as Cilbox scripts that ship inside a scene or prop.

pages.title: Synced Toggle
pages.description: A button that turns an object on or off for every player, including players who join later.

pages.title: Scoreboard
pages.description: A networked score with one owner keeping the truth and other players asking the owner to add points.

pages.title: Pickup Gun
pages.description: A synced pickup that fires when used, with the shot effect played for every player.

pages.title: Touch Button
pages.description: A button pressed by touching it with either hand, using the local player's hand bone positions.

pages.title: Seats
pages.description: Sitting players down from a script, a swivel chair, and an eject button, with Basis Seat and Basis Seat Sync.

pages.title: Zones and Teleporters
pages.description: Detecting when the local player is inside an area, teleporting them, launching them, and counting players in a lobby.

pages.title: NPC Follow
pages.description: A navigation mesh agent that follows the nearest player, simulated by one owner and sent to everyone else.

pages.title: Image Loading
pages.description: Showing a picture from a URL on a sign, with a fallback while it loads or when the player declines.

pages.title: Minimap
pages.description: A live top down minimap that follows the local player, using a camera, a render texture and an optional Graphics.Blit mask.

pages.title: Persistence
pages.description: Saving a player's progress between visits with BasisSaveShim, packing values into bytes and sharing saves between a world and its props.

pages.title: Settings Tab
pages.description: Adding world options to the player's settings menu with BasisMenuShim, and remembering them with BasisSaveShim.

pages.title: Day Night Cycle
pages.description: A sun driven by the server clock. Every player sees the same time of day and there is no networking code.

pages.title: Round Timer
pages.description: A countdown everyone sees in sync. The owner sends the end time once and every client counts down on the server clock.

pages.title: Trivia Quiz
pages.description: Questions loaded from a JSON file on the web, with the current question synced so everyone plays the same round.

pages.title: Server Best Time
pages.description: Saving each player's best lap on the server with BasisServerStorageShim, where it follows them across devices.

pages.title: Staff Door
pages.description: A door that only opens for admins and moderators, updating live when roles change.

pages.title: Voice Stage
pages.description: A stage that plays the speaker's voice from big speakers, using BasisVoiceRoutingShim.

pages.title: Drawing Board
pages.description: A shared whiteboard. Points are packed with BasisBinaryShim, the full drawing is compressed with BasisCompressionShim and sent to late joiners.

pages.title: Random Loot
pages.description: A loot chest that shows every player the same random item without sending a message, using BasisSharedRandomShim.

pages.title: Elevator
pages.description: A moving platform everyone rides together. Only the target floor is synced; every client moves the platform toward it.

pages.title: Tail Reaction
pages.description: An avatar tail that wags and squeaks when someone grabs it, using BasisJiggleEventShim.

pages.title: Hand Flashlight
pages.description: A flashlight pinned to the local player's hand without lag, using BasisBeforeRenderShim and controller input.

pages.title: Desktop and VR Input

pages.title: Localized Sign
pages.description: A sign that shows text in the player's language and switches live when they change it, using BasisLanguageEventShim.

pages.title: Performance Scaler
pages.description: Turning expensive effects down when the player's frame rate drops, using BasisStatsShim and BasisGraphicsSettingsEventShim.

pages.title: Server Portal
pages.description: A portal that offers to move the player to another Basis server, using BasisConnectionShim.
